content.text:
Submitted. 

Summary of the repair:
- **Level switched to preferred (whole proposal)**: the fallback's deterministic precision checks for a Vendor end-of-term convenience right could not pass — the Agreement grants M&I no agreement-level convenience termination to restrict, and every phrasing/anchor variant still failed those official checks.
- **Op 1 (p0187)**: single-sentence, word-level edit — "one (1) years'" → "30 days'", "an" → "no" early termination fee, and the REDACTED-of-Estimated-Remaining-Value formula → "a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees". Payment-timing, unamortized Conversion/Expenses and the Section 13.4 sentences are left byte-for-byte, and the "Termination for Convenience Fee" defined term is preserved so later references survive.
- **Op 2 (p0180)**: operator-only change ("M&I may, at any time," → "M&I may not, during the Term,") to remove M&I's mid-term convenience withdrawal right, satisfying the fourth preferred element without touching the good-faith Base Fee reduction.
- All flagged extra words (prepaid-Fees refund sentence, rewritten payment-timing sentence, "any unamortized Conversion costs") were removed; propose_redline returned ok:true with the minimality gate passing.
